text: Hello. I have this bug, im not sure what you name it, but here it is. So here is a screenshot of the compiled game loaded in. [Image #1] looks exactly as it should, If i turn my camera just slightly, this occurs, where the world starts to disappear [Image #2] i have not moved the player only the camera. when i walk around, i dont fall through the map. and at some camera angles the textures reappear
resolution: Fixed the compiled-world camera-turn disappearance at the streaming layer. The streamer was allowed to frustum-cull resident detail chunks, so an approximate visibility false negative could drop nearby floors/roads while collision remained. Resident chunks now stay visible and only nonresident far-field chunks use the frustum cull. Added a Zig regression test proving resident detail rows still draw when the camera turns away.
